about: Source table for vs-sortscape.html and vs-fergus.html. Every statement those pages make about a competitor, and every competitor figure, comes from a public page read on the date in 'seen'. tools/test-vs-pages.py reads this file: each 'figures' entry must appear in its 'quote', each 'page_text' fragment must appear on its page, every competitor cell in the comparison table must be covered by fragments listed here, and every number on a page must be a figure listed here or one of the Kept figures vetted below. Review themes are paraphrased (never quoted on the pages); the entries say which reviews they come from. Prices are the figures shown on the competitor's own public pricing page and need re-checking before they are quoted again.

Requested features: Capterra, Sharon D. (26 May 2025); Xero, Sharon Dimond and Stephen Gilligan (26 Mar 2025). Cost: Trustpilot, Mahmoud wahsheh (experience dated Jul 2025, listed Aug 2025) describes price changes every 6 to 12 months; Capterra, Dave D. (29 Nov 2018) mentions add-on costs on top of the plan.
